_note: Phone App upgrades. Same format as v0.1 upgrades.json. Weak spots are low money per fan and fans who switch, so Premium Plan and Defense fix them. cloud skips app_crash, testers skips app_bug, privacy skips app_privacy, translate skips app_banned.

trees.name: Product
trees.blurb: Make the app better so more people use it.

trees.name: Channels
trees.blurb: Get the app on more phones.

trees.name: Defense
trees.blurb: Keep your users and keep the app running.

upgrades.name: Faster App
upgrades.desc: The app opens in a flash. Every user tells more friends.

upgrades.name: Fun Filters
upgrades.desc: Silly face filters everyone wants to share. Social media works better.

upgrades.name: Translations
upgrades.desc: The app speaks 40 languages. Hard markets open up, and no country blocks you.

upgrades.name: Premium Plan
upgrades.desc: Extra features for a small monthly fee. Each user earns you much more.

upgrades.name: Privacy Mode
upgrades.desc: Users control their own data. People trust you, and data scares do not hurt you.

upgrades.name: Share Button
upgrades.desc: One tap to send the app to a friend. Works best where people are online a lot.

upgrades.name: Invite a Friend
upgrades.desc: Both friends get a free gift. The app jumps to new regions faster.

upgrades.name: Influencers
upgrades.desc: Pay creators to use the app on camera. More users and more Hype bubbles.

upgrades.name: App Store Ads
upgrades.desc: Be the first app people see in the store. Your brand jumps to new regions much faster.

upgrades.name: On Every New Phone
upgrades.desc: Phone makers put the app on new phones in shops. Growth goes up everywhere, but it costs a lot every day.

upgrades.name: Daily Streaks
upgrades.desc: Users come back every day to keep their streak. Fewer users switch to the copy.

upgrades.name: Cloud Servers
upgrades.desc: Servers that grow with you. Daily costs go down, and the app never crashes.

upgrades.name: Beta Testers
upgrades.desc: Fans test new features first. You stay ahead of copies, and bugs get caught early.

upgrades.name: Community Chat
upgrades.desc: Superfans collect Hype bubbles for you and stay loyal.

upgrades.name: Lawyers
upgrades.desc: Sue the copycat. Their copy loses 20% right now and goes slower after.
